title: Drugs, Policy, and Society
description: Examines regulations and social factors contributing to the overdose crisis in Canada. Topics may include policies related to substance use, harm reduction, policing, municipal by-laws and sex work that intersect to exacerbate cycles of poverty, hardship, oppression and ill health among vulnerable populations.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of SOCI 366, SOCI 390 (if taken in the same topic).
recommendations: SOCI 202, SOCI 206, and SOCI 285 are recommended prior to SOCI 366.
